steps.text: 11:18 P.M. \ Overcast
Rhodes Island Landship, Operator Dorms

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If you don't hurry up already, Midnight, I'm going by myself.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Give me just another minute. I'm almost done. If you have to burn the midnight oil, wouldn't you rather share the time with the finest Midnight?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I'd rather get a new partner.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hey, your terminal's ringing.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Looks like Orchid is too eager to see me. Mind taking it for me?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hell no. My hands are full of comics.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Well, then, prepare yourself for the majestic sight of my soaking wet body. Aren't you delighted you get to enjoy it for free?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Midnight, this is a private voice message for you. Transfer complete. The message will begin automatically in three seconds—

steps.name: Exhausted Female Voice
steps.text: Yoru-kun... did you get the letter I sent you? I... We don't know where you are right now, but it's been more than six months...

steps.name: Exhausted Female Voice
steps.text: They said they found a way to contact you, so I thought I would give it another try. I only hope it reaches you in time...

steps.name: Exhausted Female Voice
steps.text: Ever since I sent my last letter, your father's health has worsened, day by day. Now it's hard for him to even get out of bed...

steps.name: Exhausted Female Voice
steps.text: He... He's been staring out at the garden a lot. I think he might be waiting for a Messenger to come... He keeps telling me not to contact you, but I think it might be his last wish...

steps.name: Exhausted Female Voice
steps.text: Please, Yoru-kun, could you...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...*cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You're getting all your hair water on my comic.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I let my hair air-dry once in a while. It really brings out my charm.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You sure about that?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Of course. I know how to take care of looks.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What I'm saying is, you sure you don't want to hear the rest of the message?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I don't understand a lick of Higashinese, but still...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I thought you were waiting for me to head out? I couldn't bear to take another minute, as soon as I realized I was keeping my beloved partner waiting outside in the cold.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That's not what you said just now when you took your shower.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Whatever, we have a long night ahead of us and we aren't getting out of it. If you're ready, then let's get going.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I thought you would be on the road by now.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Who do you think slowed us down?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Good evening, Orchid. It may be late, but your makeup is perfect as always. Even the moonlight out the window looks all the more alluring, much thanks to you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You haven't forgotten what I told you last time, have you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll be deducting any time you spend talking nonsense instead of working from your overtime pay. In other words, if you want to see your paycheck for tonight's mission, you'd better stop talking now.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, Orchid, why so serious? The only thing that has ever been on my mind is helping lift the weight off your shoulders. Money means nothing to me.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Have you read the mission briefing?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: There's a young man missing nearby. Our job's to find him.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You, Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Understood. We're chasing a young man lost in the shades of evening.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Worry not, Orchid. No one escapes my charm. With me on the job, I am sure he too will...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: His parents suspect he was kidnapped by local gangsters.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If it's a kidnapping case on our hands, that's easy.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Remember not to make a ruckus. I already have enough reports to take care of.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If the boy's parents didn't have dealings with Rhodes Island, this wouldn't have been our mess at all.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Very well, my dear leader. We need only keep a low profile, right?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Although my aura can hardly be shrouded by any environment or circumstance, I accept this challenge. I am not one to give you a tough time.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: As long as you get the gist. Now go. Be quick about it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right, Midnight—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I saw a Messenger just now with an urgent message for you from Higashi. Did you get it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If you have something more urgent, I can ask Catapult to take the mission.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, Orchid, how moving. You are as considerate as a saint, and your thoughts alone are enough to move me to tears...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Get to the point. Do you need Catapult to take this or not?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...But I am not planning to let some trivial matters from back home affect our important work.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Good. Stay in contact, then.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Ugh, you sure you're fine?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My, even you are concerned about me tonight. Looks like my sincere smile has finally melted your hearts!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Yeah, sure. I'm just disappointed. I almost got a different partner.

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: Jeremy? Is that you? What are you doing here? Didn't you say you wouldn't be coming back for the foresee—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh lovely lady, don't move. Please.

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: W-Who are you people?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We are looking for the 'Jeremy' you speak of.

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: I... I don't know where he is. I already told the cops as much this afternoon...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We are no mere police.

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: What?! Then... Who are you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My lady, your friend was kidnapped by a few menacing-looking gangsters. That's what you told his parents, am I correct?

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: Erm... yes.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In that case, please take a look at the Reproba man off to the side behind you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Have you noticed his gaze? Does he seem fearsome to you?

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: D-Dear God! No way, you don't mean... you are...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Shh.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That's right. We are exactly who you think we are.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Those in our line of work will always own up to what we have done, but I'm afraid if someone tries to pin on us something we haven't done—

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: Jeremy is at the Iron Mine pub down on the corner of 18th Street!!!

steps.name: Young Citizen A
steps.text: I... I told you everything... I should never have lied for him... Please, I'm so sorry. Please don't hurt me... *sobs*...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And that's settled.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The target's hanging at the pub unharmed. No one kidnapped him; he ran away from home. Aren't you absolutely stunned? I have a fine pair of eyes that never fails to see right through a girl.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: And what was that hand signal or whatever? Were you trying to tell me to get ready to fight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Look at you. How am I to do harm to a lovely lady like her? You need only to leave these matters to me and my fabulous acting.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: And here I thought it was my weapon that did the trick.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, my darling partner. After my countless demonstrations, how do you still fail to understand?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: More often than not, words are more effective than violence.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: One more pint? No. One pint isn't enough. Give me a dozen!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Now that I've got all that weight off my shoulders, I'm drinking till I drop!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Stinking old man. He keeps making me study... What does he know?!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: I wanna make music. I'll be the hottest musician in this pub, and I'll have concerts all the way over in Siesta!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: (Claps)

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Who... Who are you?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hey, we're looking for...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We're searching for the most eurythmic sound there is.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Perhaps you'll grant me, a connoisseur of music, the chance to buy a drink for the man who will become the hottest musician to ever visit this pub?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Ha, hahaha...! Hell yeah! You've got a good eye!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Often am I told I have a particularly fine eye for beauty, but the truth is that my ears are equally sharp.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Dear musician, care to tell me what your instrument of choice is?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: I... I can play everything! Especially... guitar!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My, my. Is this your guitar? Look at its exciting colors and contours. It reminds me of a fine lady.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: I gotta hand it to you, everything you say is like music to my ears...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thank you for the compliment. Everyone has a talent, and it so happens mine lies in conversation.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: To our talents!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: To... To talents!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Well, then, young musician. Would you mind giving us a taste of the music you take such pride in?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: O-Of course! Here... Here I go!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: (Plays the guitar)

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: How... How's that? Sounds awesome, right?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My... your music truly leaves an impression.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Now that's a master BSer at work.)

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Please, continue.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (You sure? I need to put a little more distance between me and that.)

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Hah... Haha! Need an encore? Try this on for size! I-I wrote this piece just two days ago!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: (Plays the guitar)

steps.name: Customer A
steps.text: Okay, what the fricking shit is this? Boss, this crap's terrible!

steps.name: Customer B
steps.text: Yeah, if you're gonna keep torturing our ears, we're outta here!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Hey...! What are you saying?!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: My music's brilliant... What do you know? How dare you talk smack about my art!

steps.name: Customer A
steps.text: You're the one ruining our drinks with all that noise, and you're complaining? Buzz off, kid. Go back to your room and do your homework!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Is my music bad?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hm... would you like to hear the truth?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Please...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My musician friend, I'm afraid you don't have much talent for music.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: No... That's not true!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Please calm down. Even without talent, a man has the right to chase his dreams.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And as long as you persist down this path...

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: If I don't have talent, then this is all meaningless... Music... guitar... Screw it all!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: This is a beauty of a guitar. You should be more gentle with her.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: (Strums a few chords)

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: How'd you...

steps.name: Customer A
steps.text: Hey, that's a good one! Now that's more like it!

steps.name: Customer B
steps.text: Oh, new guy playing, huh? Boss, you hear this? If you're doing live music, this is the guy you should hire!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You flatter me, but I am not a musician. I merely tried my hand at guitar for a few months to entertain my customers and help them relax.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: What... Come on, man, you're just here to ruin my day, aren't you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Now that's not quite right, my young musician friend.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You're the one who tried to ruin your beloved instrument, not me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I could hand you your guitar back, but have you really put thought to how you will hold it?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There is a price to pay for fulfilling your dreams. And it costs not only sweat, but money as well... Are you sure you've made the proper preparations?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Money... Right... I don't have money!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: But I'll have money real soon! I hooked up with that gang already, and I'll be raking in lots of dough if I spend the next couple days away from home—

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: What was that for... *cough*... How dare you throw wine in my face!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Apologies, my hand slipped.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Your hand slipped...?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Perhaps that cleared your head a little?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There are many ways one can use a fine wine, and this is the most wasteful way there is.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: However, if you keep telling me you plan to work with the gangs, I don't mind wasting a few more glasses with you, until you have a perfectly clear head.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: S-Stop it already!

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: It's just making my old man cough up some money! You're the one who told me to prepare some money. Why are you against this?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My musician friend, you never needed my support. Not anyone else's either, for that matter.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Perhaps you'll find yourself a few coins richer by doing this, but that is not what I mean by 'preparation.'

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Otherwise, tell me this: have you ever wondered how your parents feel about this turn of events?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: How they feel...? I bet they're overjoyed now that they finally got rid of me!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Or perhaps... they are crying their eyes out, worried for your safety?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: No way... No way in hell.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You don't believe me, or perhaps you can't bring yourself to believe me?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If you haven't thought it through, how are you so sure you can bear the consequences for you and your parents?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: What consequences... I have no idea?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Just who are you anyway?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Apologies for not introducing myself sooner. I am an operator from Rhodes Island, and this sullen-looking Reproba gentleman is my partner.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Rhodes Island?! That's the company that sends my mother medicine...

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Are you... Are you here to look for me? Did my mother...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If my eyes do not deceive me, it seems you are worried about your mother?

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: No... definitely not!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's not so bad to look back every now and then, before you set out on a journey chasing your dreams.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If you want to go home and check on your family, my partner and I will be waiting for you at the door.

steps.name: Young Citizen B
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Mission complete—Judging from your expression, you find yourself once again stunned by my beautiful performance.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I'm just wondering... what do we do if the prick doesn't show? I don't wanna waste my strength knocking him out.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He will be here.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Back already? I was expecting you to take longer.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Our speed is thanks to my brilliant performing. Now if I fail to get five hours of sleep, my handsomeness will take a hit tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I read the brief you filed on your way back. So the boy actually ran away from home?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid, my love, please do not hesitate to compliment the accuracy of my predictions.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sounds like you got all the compliments taken care of yourself...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That boy... He has the gall to work with the gangs to swindle his parents' money. Money they need for his mother's life! And they almost handed it right to them.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Maybe we should've let the cops arrest him. That'd show him what a big mistake he made.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Worry not, Orchid. Before real tragedy could unfold, the boy who wandered astray managed to find his way back to the right path.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You sure he won't act out again?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My team leader, could you give me a little more credit?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It's not often I agree with this guy.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The kid was crying his eyes out in his arms. Even got my fur dirty.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is this another one of the Devil of the Eastern Night's 'special powers?'

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: He stood outside their front door and told the kid everything he went through, and that's how the kid turned out. Decided he was some kind of mentor. Almost didn't let him go.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What he went through?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, you still haven't told us about you and your parents.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My love, I never expected you to show such a keen interest in me...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I really wish I could say I'm not showing any interest in you whatsoever, but...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just this once, I'll listen to whatever you have to say. No, not just me. Spot too—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You dragging me into this?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Normally, you would have already snuck out of the room.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Alright, fine. Lay it on us, Midnight.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I am moved, and I suppose it's only proper if I give you two a hug? Orchid, it's a shame you aren't here in person. I have only Spot to bring into my embrace—

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Just tell the story already and keep your hands to yourself. We're never doing this again.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Well... You already heard much of the story just now.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You mean that thing about your old man beating you to a pulp out in the snow with a family heirloom sword? Where you still made the decision to leave home and chase your dreams, and you made it to the top of your industry after lots of hardships and obstacles?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Only the getting beaten part was new. The rest I've heard so many times, my ear fur almost froze over.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What happened after that isn't nearly as spectacular... On the contrary, it's incredibly boring.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: After I found my footing, I started sending some money back home every month. My mother wrote me every so often, but my father...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Knowing him, he would never forgive me. I didn't want to stoke his ire any more, so we haven't had any contact at all.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did you ever tell them you left Higashi, and about your disease?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid, my love. You've worked away from your family all these years, but you haven't told your parents about all your worries at work, have you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This is Oripathy we're talking about... My worries don't compare at all.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Right, it's a tad bit more worrying.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In Higashi, I left behind most of my savings and arranged someone to send them money every month. It was more than enough for them to live out their remaining years in comfort.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: If you were even half as amazing as you're saying you were, you wouldn't need to work for your treatment money.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Money can be earned again. Besides, my greatest asset is me myself.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But it's like you said... Do you think your parents care more about you or money? If your family still writes to you, isn't that more than enough to show that they don't just want money?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Even I have questions I can't answer, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Honestly, it's not up to us to worry about what your parents think about.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think both Spot and I are more worried about how you feel yourself.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If I have to have a question... I suppose it's a very simple one.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If someone hasn't been home for nearly two decades, is there really a need for him to go back?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What? Are you scared?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Scared? I'm the Devil of the Eastern Night.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Perhaps there are a few problems that I'm not very willing to face.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are you afraid to go home? Do you maybe regret the decision you made all those years ago?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What is there to regret when I have lived such a splendid life, free of control?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So you're worried they still don't accept you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: When I was in my teens, I suppose I merely wanted the approval of those dearest to me, just like the young man we met today.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But I got over that long ago.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're starting to lose me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I suppose... my real fear is...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Never mind. No matter what I do now, it might already be too late.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Look at me rambling on and on. The sun is about to rise. Why not hit the pub for another round?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Am I allowed to say no?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I would wager you don't actually want to say no.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Fine. That's a bet you'd win, for once.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But let me make one thing clear. If you end up drinking too much, I'm not carrying you back to the dorm.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, so heartless now? This pains me.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Know what, I'll pass...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Don't say I didn't warn you. You shouldn't drink too much before you go on a long trip.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Uhh... Did I ever say I was going on a long trip?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: In your own words? It's not so bad to look back every now and then.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Look back, huh...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Your terminal's still on. Looks like that message is starting to play again...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'll see you tomorrow, my dear partner.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hey, I told you already. I don't understand a lick of Higashinese!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Also, if you're going to take a break, don't forget to tell Orchid. I don't want to get any of your work.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Voice message.

a.text: Yoru-kun, your father made it this long because he wants to see you again.
He would never say anything, but I know. He wants to tell you the same thing I do.
We just want to tell you...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Sorry...?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Haha... What was I so afraid of...?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If you've apologized, then... I have no reason to avoid going home?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: A ticket to Higashi...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Well, I suppose I'll write back before I buy it.
